solution.title: Secure Microsoft 365 Copilot — Oversharing & SharePoint Permissions Remediation

products.name: Secure Microsoft 365 Copilot — Oversharing & SharePoint Permissions Remediation — Commercial
products.short_description: Close the Copilot oversharing gap — find and fix over-permissioned SharePoint/OneDrive content before Copilot surfaces it.
products.description:
Close the Copilot oversharing gap — find and fix over-permissioned SharePoint/OneDrive content before Copilot surfaces it.

Copilot can surface anything a user technically has access to — and most tenants are riddled with over-shared sites, 'Everyone' links, and stale permissions. This solution discovers oversharing, applies SharePoint Advanced Management and Restricted Content Discovery, remediates broad access, and verifies Copilot only sees what it should.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Oversharing discovery — broad-access sites, 'Everyone/EEEU', anonymous links
  • SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM) controls and Restricted Content Discovery
  • Site access reviews and permission remediation
  • Sensitivity-label + DLP alignment so Copilot respects boundaries
  • Validation that Copilot responses honor the corrected permissions

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Copilot that respects your real access boundaries — the oversharing closed before it becomes a data-leak headline.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CPLTSHARE-AccessReview.ps1 — Produce a per-site access-review workbook for owner-led cleanup (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTSHARE-Discovery.ps1 — Discover SharePoint/OneDrive oversharing that Copilot can surface (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTSHARE-Remediation.ps1 — Build the access-reduction list and (only with -Commit) reduce oversharing
    • CPLTSHARE-Report.ps1 — Compile the before/after oversharing-remediation evidence record (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTSHARE-Validate.ps1 — Confirm the pilot oversharing is reduced and controls are in the expected state (READ-ONLY)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
